svg.title: R2DBC Redisson Repository Boundary
svg.desc: Architecture diagram for exposed-r2dbc-redisson showing coroutine repository calls, writer-backed Redisson maps, cache-only invalidation, and R2DBC loader/writer transactions.
svg.text: A suspend repository fronts Redisson maps; misses and writer callbacks cross into Exposed R2DBC transactions.

g.text: Boundary rule: invalidation removes Redis state by default; database row deletion is opt-in and batched through the R2DBC writer.
